validation.root: Positive sub-wad payments are discarded across public checkpoints with no carried remainder.
validation.distinctFromTruth: MCB-006 is a negative-product floor error. The two signed domains have reciprocal non-fixing controls.
validation.distinguishingRepair: Carry position remainder or round positive payer obligations up; signed floor alone does not fix it.
validation.evidence: Ten split checkpoints pay zero versus one wei unsplit, including under the MCB-006 signed-floor patch.

validation.root: The uint64 nonce word index is narrowed to uint8 after shifting.

validation.distinguishingRepair: Store the full nonce>>8 word index.
validation.evidence: Nonce 0 and 65,536 collide; adjacent nonce 1 remains independent.
